description.value:
Prerequisite: Must have Idle Death Gamble

Through thorough understanding of your domain, you can now manifest Pachinko Attacks outside your domain and have a 30 foot range when used this way. Whenever you use a Pachinko Attack, you add your Cursed Energy modifier to the damage rolls. Additionally, you reduce the Cursed Energy cost of your Pachinko Attacks by 1 CE. This reduces the CE cost of Green Balls to 0 CE, but cannot reduce the CE cost of other Pachinko Attacks to 0 CE (minimum of 1). These attacks do not build Expectation.
